fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

eligible_majors.notes: Mapped directly from agreement_scope_raw='University-wide'; see excluded_majors/course_restrictions_note for host exceptions.

english_course_availability.notes: Many English-taught and bilingual courses, particularly at the Master's level; UG programs remain predominantly German-taught in several schools.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: B1 or B2 CEFR level in German and/or English depending on host TUM department (TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge, or signed TUM Language Template / institutional CEFR verification max 2 years old; self-assessments NOT accepted). RHET 1020 waiver not explicitly mentioned.

host_language_requirement.value: B1 or B2 German required if taking German-taught modules (varies by TUM school/department); English-only Master's tracks require English B1/B2 instead.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Winter Semester: Oct 1, 2026-Mar 31, 2027; Lectures Oct 12, 2026-Feb 5, 2027; Exams Feb-Mar 2027 (transcripts available by Apr 30, 2027 per 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p. 1).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Summer Semester: Apr 1, 2027-Sep 30, 2027; Lectures Apr 12-Jul 16, 2027; Exams Jul-Sep 2027 (transcripts available by Nov 5, 2027 per 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p. 1).

tuition_model.notes: 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p. 2 confirms NO tuition fee for exchange students (only mandatory semester fee applies).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Sum of itemized Munich/Garching monthly exchange estimates on Fact Sheet p. 2 (Food €300 + Books €40 + Personal €150 + Health insurance €150 + Housing €350-€500 dorm or €650-€1,000 private), excluding Deutschlandticket semester pass (note: https://www.gs.tum.de/en/services/living-and-working/cost-of-living/ estimates €1,300-€2,000/month overall in Munich).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Midpoint 1315 EUR/month * 5 months * 1.1052 USD/EUR = 7266.69 USD (ECB reference rate dated 2026-11-13, collected 2026-11-15: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory Studentenwerk semester fee €97.00/semester (Munich/Garching/Weihenstephan baseline, plus Deutschlandticket if applicable); mandatory statutory/recognized German health insurance (~€150/month per 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p. 2-3).

housing_availability.notes: Limited Munich Student Union dorm rooms / Service Package allocated via TUM; high demand often requires private market rooms (€650-€1,000/month).

housing_notes.value: Limited Student Union dormitories (€350-€500/month) via TUM housing support; private rooms €650-€1,000/month in Munich/Garching.

host_grants_or_stipends.value: No TUM scholarships available for incoming exchange students; DAAD scholarship database linked as external resource.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EFTA/non-exempt citizens MUST obtain a student visa in their home country prior to arrival (tourist visas disallowed; Munich KVR foreign office wait times can take up to 12 months!). Requires proof of €992/month (€11,904/year via blocked account / Sperrkonto or scholarship/sponsor per tum.de).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: €992/month statutory blocked account threshold confirmed on https://www.global.tum.de/en/studies/international-students/degree-students/visa-and-residency/.

course_catalog_url.notes: Dynamic TUMonline portal: filter by '98 Exchange programs' or Courses -> Language of instruction: English.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system: typical full-time load is ~30 ECTS per semester.

course_restrictions_note.value: Maximum exchange duration 2 semesters; external-only internships without coursework are not permitted; students must choose a primary host TUM school and meet departmental language prerequisites (B1/B2).

value: Letter of Motivation (1 DIN A4 page, English or German)
Language Certificate or signed TUM Language Template (B1/B2)
Copy of Passport or ID Card
Study plan / Learning Agreement / OLA (earliest signature after admission)
required_application_docs.notes: Confirmed via tum.de incoming exchange checklist and TUM_GAO_Incoming_Fact_Sheet_2026-2027.pdf#page=2-3 (note: €992/month blocked account is a separate post-admission visa/residence requirement, not a TUMexchange application upload).

campus_type.notes: Campuses across Munich, Garching, Freising (Weihenstephan), Straubing, and Heilbronn (also https://www.tum.de/en/about-tum/locations).

international_support_services.value: TUM Global & Alumni Office advising, TUMi orientation weeks before lectures (Apr 1-11, 2027 in Summer per tum.de), buddy/mentor integration, and KVR immigration guidance.

nomination_deadlines.value: Winter 2026/27: Nomination mid-Mar-Apr 30; Application mid-Mar-May 10. Summer 2027: Nomination mid-Sep-Oct 17; Application mid-Sep-Oct 31.
